vocabulary.name: ClaimTriage
vocabulary.description: Facts and thresholds the ClaimTriage policy reasons over. Every term binds to an element of the TriageFacts document.

version.description: Added PolicyAgeDaysAtLoss for the new-policy fraud rule

vocabularydefinition.name: Claim net exposure
vocabularydefinition.description: EstimatedAmount capped at the coverage limit, less the deductible, never below zero.

vocabularydefinition.name: Claim reserve estimate
vocabularydefinition.description: Initial reserve computed by the InsertClaim_to_TriageFacts map.

vocabularydefinition.name: Claim report delay days
vocabularydefinition.description: Days between loss date and reported date.

vocabularydefinition.name: Policy age days at loss
vocabularydefinition.description: Days between policy effective date and loss date.

vocabularydefinition.name: Claimant has prior fraud flag
vocabularydefinition.description: PriorFraudFlagInd from the FNOL, false when absent.

vocabularydefinition.name: Policy in force at loss
vocabularydefinition.description: Computed by Claim_PolicyInqRs_to_InsertClaim from status, effective and expiration dates.

vocabularydefinition.name: Triage outcome
vocabularydefinition.description: Set by the policy. Empty until a rule fires.

vocabularydefinition.name: Add triage reason
vocabularydefinition.description: Appends a Reason element to the facts document.

vocabularydefinition.name: Fast-track exposure limit
vocabularydefinition.description: Net exposure at or below this settles from the desk.

vocabularydefinition.name: Late report threshold days
vocabularydefinition.description: Reports later than this are referred to the fraud desk.

vocabularydefinition.name: New policy window days
vocabularydefinition.description: Losses inside this many days of inception are new-policy losses.

vocabularydefinition.name: New policy large loss amount
vocabularydefinition.description: Estimate above this inside the new-policy window refers to the fraud desk.

vocabularydefinition.name: Large loss reserve threshold
vocabularydefinition.description: Reserves at or above this go to the large-loss unit.

vocabularydefinition.name: Fast-track loss causes
vocabularydefinition.description: Comma-separated causes eligible for fast track.
